trang-nguoi-dung.label: Trang Người Dùng
trang-nguoi-dung.description: Giao diện chính cho người dùng: trang chủ, about, contact, bio-music, layout chung, navbar, footer, hero sections.

blog-system.label: Blog System
blog-system.description: Hệ thống blog: danh sách bài viết, chi tiết bài viết, article content rendering, related posts, breadcrumb, schema markup, SEO blog.

admin-cms.label: Admin CMS
admin-cms.description: Trang quản trị: dashboard admin, CRUD blog/case-studies/events/gallery/music/services/shop, RichTextEditor, SEO score.

shop-affiliate.label: Shop / Affiliate
shop-affiliate.description: Cửa hàng & affiliate: danh sách sản phẩm, chi tiết sản phẩm, giỏ hàng, Shopee affiliate, product card.

3d-website.label: 3D Website (Three.js)
3d-website.description: Hiệu ứng 3D: Three.js canvas, character models, particle fields, shaders, spotlight, teleport beam, post-processing.

authentication.label: Authentication
authentication.description: Xác thực: NextAuth, API auth, middleware, admin route protection, JWT, session management.

api-routes.label: API Routes
api-routes.description: API endpoints: blog CRUD, webhook sync, shop API, media upload, newsletter, SEO settings, gallery.

core-library.label: Core Library
core-library.description: Thư viện dùng chung: SEO utils, database connection, site defaults, shader utils, hooks (useCanvasOptimizer, useHydrated, useVisibilityLoader).

data-storage.label: Data & Storage
data-storage.description: Dữ liệu: JSON files cho blog, case-studies, events, gallery, music, shop, services.

scripts-automation.label: Scripts & Automation
scripts-automation.description: Kịch bản tự động: sync blog, SEO audit, shop scraper, image optimization, Google indexing, DB backup.

config.label: Configuration
config.description: Cấu hình dự án: Next.js, Tailwind, PostCSS, jsconfig, ESLint, env variables.
